blind.description: A stylized red and bronze dragon figurine perched upright on a round decorative plinth. The dragon has red scaled skin, a ribbed golden-bronze underbelly, golden horns, folded leathery wings edged in gold/bronze, and a thick tail coiling along the perimeter of the base. Surfaces are continuous, smooth, and stylized in a hand-painted fantasy game asset aesthetic, with no floating geometry, holes, or untextured patches.
blind.from_above: From directly above, the dragon's head and horns project forward, flanked by the tops of its folded wings and the rounded rim of the circular base below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (approx. 2.8 ft tall), and about 2 ft wide at the base.

notes: Height proportion is somewhat squatter than catalog ratio (1.12:1 vs 2.0:1) due to wide coiled tail and plinth footprint, but reads clearly as an upright dragon idol
